t: Where to shop in London: the ultimate neighbourhood guide | CN Traveller
s: February 12, 2025 - There are the more chi chi neighbourhoods such as Mayfair’s Mount Street, which is the place to go to discover London’s lux labels such as Erdem, Simone Rocha, and jewellery favourite Jessica McCormack, or the King’s Road, running between Chelsea and Fulham, which blends the best of the high street with independent emerging brands. Don’t overlook the newer shopping destinations such as Shoreditch and Brixton, which have more independent boutiques, concept stores, pop-ups, and international sellers.
